abstract: OBJECTIVE: To enhance diagnostic precision by integrating the O-RADS MRI score with clinical and imaging criteria for histopathological subtyping. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study analyzed data from the EURAD (EURopean ADnexal study) database between 2013 and 2018. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were performed to identify features potentially associated with presumed final histology. RESULTS: The study encompassed 869 adnexal lesions from 651 patients (mean age: 49.7, STD: 16.1). On multivariate analysis, the presence of fatty content (OR = 126.5, CI(95%) [43.6-367.1]) and multiple different signal T1W/T2W signals of cystic component (OR = 4.0, CI(95%) [1.8-8.8]) were strongly associated with mature cystic teratomas. Endometriomas were predicted by endometriotic fluid (OR = 20.7, CI(95%) [10.5-40.7]) and ADC values (× 10(-3) mm²/s) of cystic component (ADC(CT)) < 2 (OR = 3.8, CI(95%) [1.7-8.7]). Similarly, voluminous multilocular cysts with > 10 loculi (OR = 4.3, CI(95%) [1.7-10.7]) were indicative of benign mucinous cystadenomas. The analysis also highlighted the significance of ADC values in distinguishing between benign and infiltrative lesions. Unilocular cysts with ADC(CT) > 2 (OR = 11.1, CI(5%) [3.8-32.8]) were strongly associated with benign serous cystadenomas. ADC of solid tissue (ADC(ST)) with mural nodule morphology < 1.08 (OR = 3.3, 95%, CI(95%) [1.5-7.5]) was predictive of primary invasive tumors, whereas ADC(ST) > 1.08 (OR = 3.6, CI(95%) [1.2-10.7]) with papillary projection was predictive of borderline tumors. CONCLUSION: Combining the O-RADS MRI score with morphology, size, type of solid tissue and cystic component, including ADC values, enhances the precision of diagnosing presumed histological subtypes. KEY POINTS: Question Does integrating the O-RADS MRI score with clinical and imaging criteria improve diagnostic precision for histopathological subtyping? Findings Combining the O-RADS MRI score with specific clinical or imaging features improved the prediction of borderline, primary invasive, or metastatic tumors. Clinical relevance Combining the O-RADS MRI score with morphological and clinical features can help differentiate ovarian tumors thereby improving patient management, as this can help guide treatment decisions, avoid unnecessary surgeries, and streamline the referral process to specialized care.
abstract_ja: 目的：O-RADS MRIスコアを臨床・画像所見と統合し、組織病理学的なサブタイプの診断精度を高めること。方法：EURAD（欧州付属器研究）データベースの2013年から2018年のデータを解析した後方視的研究。単変量および多変量ロジスティック回帰分析を行い、推定される最終組織学と関連する可能性のある因子を同定した。結果：651例の患者（平均年齢49.7歳、標準偏差16.1）の869個の付属器病変を対象とした。多変量解析では、脂肪成分の存在（OR=126.5、95%CI 43.6〜367.1）と嚢胞成分の複数の異なるT1W/T2W信号（OR=4.0、95%CI 1.8〜8.8）が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と強く関連した。子宮内膜症性液体（OR=20.7、95%CI 10.5〜40.7）と、嚢胞成分のADC値（×10^-3 mm²/s）<2（OR=3.8、95%CI 1.7〜8.7）が子宮内膜症性嚢胞を予測した。同様に、10房を超える大きな多房性嚢胞（OR=4.3、95%CI 1.7〜10.7）は良性粘液性嚢胞腺腫を示唆した。ADC値は良性病変と浸潤性病変の鑑別にも有用であった。ADC(CT)>2を伴う単房性嚢胞（OR=11.1、95%CI 3.8〜32.8）は良性漿液性嚢胞腺腫と強く関連した。壁在結節形態の充実成分のADC(ST)<1.08（OR=3.3、95%CI 1.5〜7.5）は原発性浸潤性腫瘍を予測し、乳頭状突起を伴うADC(ST)>1.08（OR=3.6、95%CI 1.2〜10.7）は境界悪性腫瘍を予測した。結論：O-RADS MRIスコアに、形態、大きさ、充実成分と嚢胞成分の種類（ADC値を含む）を組み合わせることで、推定される組織学的サブタイプの診断精度が高まる。要点：課題：O-RADS MRIスコアを臨床・画像所見と統合することで、組織病理学的サブタイプの診断精度は向上するか。所見：O-RADS MRIスコアと特定の臨床または画像所見を組み合わせることで、境界悪性、原発性浸潤性、転移性腫瘍の予測が向上した。臨床的意義：O-RADSと形態・臨床所見を組み合わせることで卵巣腫瘍の鑑別に役立ち、治療方針の決定、不要な手術の回避、専門施設への紹介の効率化に寄与しうる。
